items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: No, just on Sundays, you know. We'd go over there just for people we know... But the band, Lori, we played over past Christiana.

ctx.x: He had Charlie McCurtis on the clarinet. Mm-hmm. He had Buddy Christian on the guitar. Walter Brundee on the drums. Mm-hmm. And John was on the violin. And Kimmel, not Andrew Kimmel, before Andrew Kimmel was a fellow that built. Jim Williams was playing trumpet. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. That's before Andrew, and Kimball came in.
Yeah, and Kimball was with him in the 20s, I believe. Late years.
